Your phone listens and reads replies aloud. Free, and works with any model, your ChatGPT plan included.
Natural back-and-forth voice from Google. Needs a Gemini API key.
Natural back-and-forth voice from OpenAI. Needs an OpenAI API key.
With Gemini Live or OpenAI Realtime, the voice model talks with you and hands real jobs to Orbit, so phone control and every other tool still work in a call. Calls are billed to your own API key.

Paste a key from Google AI Studio
Google has no official way for other apps to use a Google AI Pro or Ultra plan, so this needs an API key from Google AI Studio.

Sign in with ChatGPT lets Orbit use your Plus or Pro plan for chats, but OpenAI only offers that for text, not live voice. To use your plan in a call, pick Built-in: it talks through whichever model you chat with.
